instruction: A candid action photograph taken in a grassy park during a teambuilding event. In the background, the bald man in the navy t-shirt (R2) stands holding a white inflatable bowling pin over his shoulder, shouting playfully with his mouth open. In the foreground, the woman in the navy t-shirt (R4) ducks slightly with her hands raised defensively, reacting with a surprised expression. A red and white banner hangs behind them in the trees. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting their playful interaction.
